SRC-021:R1.text: Ownership stays split and unduplicated: SAIPEN owns semantic truth (whether useful autonomous work remains, whether the project is genuinely complete, whether continuation requires a human or external event, and whether current convergence is valid for the latest audit generation), while SAIPATCH owns only transport automation (observing the OpenCode completed/idle boundary, querying SAIPEN machine status, enqueueing at most one synthetic cc, stopping at completion or any unsafe boundary). Neither side reimplements the other's logic.

SRC-021:R2.text: The only machine surface SAIPATCH consumes is read-only 'saipen status --json', which must expose an 'automation' block carrying schema_version, disposition (CONTINUE|COMPLETE|WAIT_USER|WAIT_EXTERNAL|BLOCKED|INVALID), next_command, reason_code, reason, audit_quiescent, audit_epoch, convergence_current, closure_complete, source_fingerprint and completed_at.

SRC-021:R3.text: next_command is 'cc' only for disposition CONTINUE and null for every other disposition; unknown schema version or unknown disposition fails closed; assistant prose is never machine authority; the human-readable SAIPEN_CLOSURE_COMPLETE marker may be printed but must never be parsed as truth.
